name: Rowilu
source:
The commander in chief of the Val Fasq No.2 invasion fleet. He is not prone to getting into long debates like other enemies; upon his introduction he simply gives a speech  that they will all be crushed and they have no hope to win, and then cuts the communication.

[From [url=http://galaxyangel.wikia.com/wiki/Rowilu]Galaxy Angel Wiki[/url]]
